premises.text: People need advice, jobs, and opportunities beyond the limits of their social graphs and beyond today's narrow bots
premises.evidence_span: even the most well-connected of us are severely limited in our reach via our social graphs

premises.text: Sensei is one messenger contact that matches users to humans via NLP understanding of need and a match-and-dispatch algorithm
premises.evidence_span: Sensei is one contact with the experience of millions of people

premises.text: Cross-platform anonymous-by-default chats include ratings and tipping as a transactional conversation marketplace
premises.evidence_span: It's a conversation marketplace in which users transact and chat commerce

premises.text: Availability spans major messengers and is expanding globally into Line, WeChat, and Skype
premises.evidence_span: Sensei is going global, launching in line, WeChat, and Skype in beta

value.text: Chat with awesome humans you do not know for advice, referrals, opportunities, and jobs
value.evidence_span: We need to chat with awesome humans that we don't know

causal_links.evidence_span: what we really need is human conversation
Sensei will match you with an awesome human to chat with
Sensei is also available in Kik, Telegram, and in text message

notes: NLP, match/dispatch, real-time indexing, anonymity, ratings, and tipping folded as facets of one conversation-marketplace mechanism where tightly chained; tipping/rating kept inside marketplace commercial surface (§4.1.7).
